sn5.8:1.1: Sāvatthiyaṃ || || Atha kho Sīsupacālā bhikkhunī pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā || pa || aññatarasmiṃ rukkhumūle divāvihāraṃ nisīdi || || Atha kho Māro pāpimā yena Sīsupacālā bhikkhunī tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Sīsupacālam bhikkhunim etad avoca || || Kassa nu tvaṃ bhikkhuni pāsaṇḍaṃ rocesīti || || Na khvāham āvuso kassaci pāsaṇḍaṃ rocemī ti || ||
sn5.8:2.1: Kiṃ nu uddissa muṇḍāsi || samaṇī viya dissasi || na ca rocesi pāsaṇḍaṃ || kim-iva carasi momuhā ti || ||
sn5.8:3.1: Ito bahiddhā pāsaṇḍā || diṭṭhīsu pasīdanti ye || na tesaṃ dhammam rocemi || na te dhammassa kovidā || ||
sn5.8:4.1: Atthi sakya-kule jāto || buddho appaṭipuggalo || sabbābhibhū māranudo || sabbattham aparājito ||
sn5.8:5.1: sabbatthamutto asito || sabbam passati cakkhumā || || sabbakammakkhayaṃ patto || vimutto upadhisaṅkhaye || so mayhaṃ Bhagavā satthā || tassa rocemi sāsanan ti
